name: Hachijou Tooya
source:
Hachijou Tooya is implied to be the real author of forgeries about the Rokkenjima murders, since Banquet of the Golden Witch, which were his way to cope with the memories. Together, with Hachijou Ikuko, they share the alias of "Hachijou Tooya" and "Itouikukuro".

[spoiler]Tooya was found on the road by Hachijou Ikuko after the Rokkenjima incident. He was [url=/c196]Ushiromiya Battler[/url] once, but after receiving brain damage from being hit by a car or from almost drowning, he suffered from amnesia. The accident made him unable to think of Battler's memories as his own. He began to recover his memories as Battler upon hearing of the Rokkenjima incident from Ikuko, but develops a personality disorder; he fears that, one day, Battler's personality may seize control of him.

At the end of the Magic Ending in Twilight of the Golden Witch, it's implied that Battler finally died and Tooya could start living without the burden of Battler.[/spoiler]
